about: Tooltips by key: a component's name (a toolbar id, a catalogued menu item's id, or a literal setName), or 'Section/label' for an unnamed control, where Section is the title of the sidebar section it sits in (or the class of the panel that built it) and label is the text on the control or on the label just before it. A tooltip the code sets wins; these fill the controls that have none. Help > Report Controls Without Tooltips logs each control still missing one, with its key. See docs/tips-and-tooltips.md.

tooltips.imageLayersNew: Add an image layer for the time range and time step beside it: Helioviewer JPEG 2000, FITS through the VSO, or a mission's own archive
tooltips.TimelinePanel/New Layer: Add a timeline layer to the plot under the picture
tooltips.projectionOrthographic: Draw the Sun in 3D as seen from the observer; drag on the canvas to turn it
tooltips.projectionHPC: A flat helioprojective-cartesian map of the sky around the Sun
tooltips.projectionHelioradial: A flat radial map centred on the Sun; Warp, below, stretches its radial axis
tooltips.projectionHelioradialUnrolled: The helioradial map unrolled: position angle along one screen axis, distance from the Sun along the other
tooltips.projectionLatitudinal: A flat map of the solar surface in longitude and latitude
tooltips.ViewpointLayerOptionsPanel/Free: See the scene from the active image layer's observer; the trackball, pan and axis stay live
tooltips.ViewpointLayerOptionsPanel/Follow: See the scene from a selected object, interpolated over the movie
tooltips.ViewpointLayerOptionsPanel/Overview: Look down on the solar equatorial plane, with the planets and the Parker spiral
tooltips.ViewpointLayerOptionsPanel/Instrument di: Put the camera in the observer's direction at the instrument's own distance from the Sun
tooltips.ViewpointLayerOptionsPanel/1 au: Put the camera in the observer's direction at 1 au from the Sun
tooltips.TurntableOptions/Frames/rev: How many frames one full revolution takes, when the camera runs on its own clock
tooltips.TurntableOptions/°/s: How many degrees the camera turns per second, when it runs on the movie clock
tooltips.TurntableOptions/Axis lon: Longitude of the axis the camera revolves about, in degrees
tooltips.TurntableOptions/lat: Latitude of the axis the camera revolves about, in degrees
tooltips.CadencePanel/Time step: The time between frames for the next layer
tooltips.Annotation/Rectangle: Hold Shift and drag on the canvas to draw a rectangle
tooltips.Annotation/Circle: Hold Shift and drag on the canvas to draw a circle
tooltips.Annotation/Cross: Hold Shift and drag on the canvas to draw a cross
tooltips.Annotation/FOV: Hold Shift and drag on the canvas to draw a field of view; Fit FOV Annotation then zooms to it
tooltips.Annotation/Line: Hold Shift and drag on the canvas to draw a line
tooltips.Annotation/Loop: Hold Shift and drag on the canvas to draw a loop
tooltips.Annotation/Fit FOV Annotation: Zoom the view to the field of view annotation
tooltips.Annotation/Clear Annotations: Remove every annotation from the canvas
tooltips.Grid/Grid labels: Label the grid lines with their coordinates
tooltips.Grid/Radial grid: Draw the rings and spokes of the radial grid
tooltips.Grid/Grid type: The frame the grid is drawn in: the viewpoint's own, Stonyhurst, Carrington or heliocentric inertial (HCI)
tooltips.Grid/Longitude: Spacing between longitude lines, in degrees
tooltips.Grid/Latitude: Spacing between latitude lines, in degrees
tooltips.Grid/Line opacity: How opaque the grid lines are, from 0 (hidden) to 100
tooltips.Grid/Label opacity: How opaque the grid labels are, from 0 (hidden) to 100
tooltips.Grid/Ring label angle: The angle around the Sun, in degrees, at which the rings are labelled
tooltips.Solar limb/Opacity: How opaque the limb circle is, from 0 (hidden) to 100
tooltips.Solar limb/Line width: Thickness of the limb circle, from a quarter to four times the default
tooltips.Thomson sphere/Opacity: How opaque the wireframe is, from 0 (hidden) to 100
tooltips.Thomson sphere/Line width: Thickness of the lines, from a quarter to four times the default
tooltips.Thomson sphere/Density: How many lines are drawn, from a quarter to four times the default
tooltips.Celestial sphere/Opacity: How opaque the wireframe is, from 0 (hidden) to 100
tooltips.Celestial sphere/Line width: Thickness of the lines, from a quarter to four times the default
tooltips.Celestial sphere/Density: How many lines are drawn, from a quarter to four times the default
tooltips.Ecliptic plane/Opacity: How opaque the plane's lines are, from 0 (hidden) to 100
tooltips.Ecliptic plane/Line width: Thickness of the lines, from a quarter to four times the default
tooltips.Ecliptic plane/Density: How many lines are drawn, from a quarter to four times the default
tooltips.Planets/Names: Label each planet with its name
tooltips.Planets/Orbit opacity: How opaque the orbits are, from 0 (hidden) to 100
tooltips.CactusTrackPanel/Details…: Show the event information for the selected CME
tooltips.*/Cancel: Close this window without changing anything
tooltips.Display/Opacity: How strongly this layer is drawn, from 0 (invisible) to 100
tooltips.Display/Blend: How much this layer covers the layers under it: at 100 it hides them, at 0 its light is added on top of theirs
tooltips.Intensity/None: Show each frame as it is
tooltips.Intensity/Running: Running difference: each frame minus the frame shown before it
tooltips.Intensity/Base: Base difference: each frame minus the first frame
tooltips.Intensity/Levels: Where the darkest and brightest data land in grey: drag either handle to set the brightness window
tooltips.Intensity/Sharpen: Right sharpens the picture, left softens it; 0 leaves it as it is
tooltips.FITSSettings/Percentile 0.001%: Scale the data between its 0.001% percentiles, taken from a sample of its pixels, so only the most extreme pixels clip
tooltips.FITSSettings/Percentile 0.5%: Scale the data between its 0.5% percentiles, taken from a sample of its pixels, so the faintest and brightest few pixels clip
tooltips.FITSSettings/Range: Scale the data over its whole range, from a sample of its pixels
tooltips.Geometry/Mask: Show only the band between the two handles, in solar radii from Sun centre; the top of the slider means no outer limit
tooltips.Geometry/Sector: The direction the sector of the frame you keep points in, in degrees
tooltips.Geometry/Opening: How wide the sector you keep is, in degrees; 0 keeps the whole frame
tooltips.Geometry/Slit: Keep only the strip between the two handles, as a share of the frame's width
tooltips.Alignment/δCROTA: A correction to the frame's roll angle (CROTA), in degrees
tooltips.Alignment/δCRVAL1: A correction to the frame's pointing along x (CRVAL1), in arcseconds
tooltips.Alignment/δCRVAL2: A correction to the frame's pointing along y (CRVAL2), in arcseconds
tooltips.Filters/Pass: Keep only the motion between From and To
tooltips.Filters/Notch: Remove the motion between From and To and keep the rest
tooltips.Filters/From: The low end of the band of motion, in km/s for radial velocity or degrees per hour for angular
tooltips.Filters/To: The high end of the band of motion, in km/s for radial velocity or degrees per hour for angular
tooltips.Filters/Direction: Which way the motion must go to count: both ways, or one
tooltips.Filters/Radial bins: How many bins in radius the movie is resampled into before filtering; more needs more memory
tooltips.Filters/Angular bins: How many bins around the Sun the movie is resampled into before filtering; more needs more memory
tooltips.Filters/Spectrum…: The measured spectrum, with a live preview while you drag the band; it is measured while a velocity filter runs
tooltips.Filters/Gate: Hard drops what falls below the noise threshold; Wiener scales it down smoothly
tooltips.Filters/Size: The side of each neighbourhood the noise is estimated in, in pixels and frames
tooltips.Filters/Show the residual (what was remo: Show what the filter removed instead of what it kept
